ticket.title: miter deps tier 3: feature inventory, per-feature cost estimates and dead feature detection
ticket.description: Tier 3 of miter deps, deferred until the GB-160 audit proves features are the right mechanism for a given case. (1) --features: per feature, the gated items (#[cfg(feature)] sites), the optional dependencies it unlocks, and who enables it - the feature-unification blame that cargo still explains poorly. (2) --feature-cost <name>: the estimated tree delta of default-features = false from the intersection of optional dependencies and gated items, labelled an estimate because it is not a build. (3) --dead-features: features declared with no gated item and gated items with no feature, catching both halves of drift. Explicitly must not pretend to compile feature combinations - cargo hack owns that. Depends on GB-161.
